gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more free time these days.
gaps.hint: if only plus past, present wish
gaps.explanation: 'If only' works like 'wish' and takes the past simple for present regrets: had.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: I'd have helped if I ___ about the problem.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.sentence: If you had watered the plants, they ___.
gaps.hint: negative unreal past result with would
gaps.explanation: The unreal past result takes 'would not have' plus the past participle: would not have died.

gaps.sentence: I will tell her the news when I ___ her at the party.
gaps.hint: when clauses take present for future
gaps.explanation: Time clauses with future meaning use the present simple, not 'will': see.

gaps.sentence: Had I ___ the risks, I would never have invested.
gaps.explanation: After inverted 'Had I', the past participle follows: known.

gaps.sentence: He wouldn't be so tired today ___ so late last night.
gaps.explanation: Past condition with present result: if + past perfect, would + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me tonight, I will send you the files first thing.
gaps.explanation: A realistic future condition uses the present simple after 'if': email.
